market.hypothesis: The market mid price is the best available estimate (baseline to beat).

longshot.hypothesis: Favorite-longshot bias: cheap contracts are overpriced, so true probabilities are more extreme than prices.
longshot.retired: 2026-11-10: FAILURE_RETIRE (no measurable edge after 832 resolved; backtest 1334, no difference). Owner approved.

memory.hypothesis: Series memory: a series' own past gap between outcome and price persists, so shifting the price by that gap (shrunk when history is short) beats the price.
memory.retired: 2026-11-12: turned off (config v10). 1,164 resolved live markets: Brier vs market +0.0031 (worse), no pick edge. memory.mjs stays as a feature source for the models.

nn.hypothesis: A small neural network trained on settled markets (price, spread, time of day, category, series memory) can correct the market price. Starts equal to the market; judged only on data it never trained on.

crypto_fair.hypothesis: Outside data: a coin's Coinbase spot price and recent volatility (random-walk model) price Kalshi crypto strikes better than the market.

weather_nws.hypothesis: Outside data: the latest NWS station observation plus the forecast's change to the target hour prices Kalshi hourly temperature markets better than the market.
weather_nws.retired: 2026-11-12: turned OFF (config v10), not retired. +0.335 Brier vs market, 4/30 paper wins: it read one NWS airport station while Kalshi settles on a Synoptic Data metro index. Comes back only after a rebuild against the settlement methodology passes its regression test.

calib.hypothesis: A logistic correction of the market price (price, time left, spread, microprice, book imbalance, trade flow, volatility, outside data, series history, category) refit on every settlement beats the price. Capped at ±10 points from the market.

ensemble.hypothesis: A logistic blend of the active models (calib, nn, crypto_fair) and the market, trained only on their out-of-sample estimates, beats the price. Capped at ±10 points from the market.

portfolios.name: Crypto fair value, learned bet size

storage.note: archive.mjs moves hot logs older than last month (or over maxHotMB) to data/archive/ as verified gzip; storage.mjs watches sizes.

publish.note: main = code + append-only logs; site = derived files, one force-pushed commit (GitHub Pages).

calib.note: l2 chosen 2026-11-12 by walk-forward on data settled before the freeze (5 values tried: 5, 20, 50, 200, 1000). All were slightly WORSE than the market (+0.0007…+0.0016 Brier); 200 kept as strong shrinkage.

nn.note: three architectures/input sets were tried on 2026-11-10 (see lessons.md)

evals.note: Verdicts come only from live predictions (logged before resolution by a model trained on earlier-settled markets), judged by a confidence sequence that stays valid under constant peeking. alpha is split across every predictor and variant ever tried (Bonferroni). Settings were chosen on data settled before frozenAt; nothing after it is used for tuning.
